facts.text: أحتاج مساعدتك في صياغة عرض سعر للعميل الألماني بخصوص تجديد المطبخ
facts.note: goal capture is length-based — full Arabic request becomes a Session Goal verbatim

facts.text: دائماً حافظ على نبرة رسمية وودودة في رسائل العميل
facts.note: Arabic pref: whitelist is English-only — zero header coverage; survives ONLY as verbatim tail
mid-session German email body: refs inside unparsed prose — pre-brief-tail measured drop
Arabic-Indic digits: all ID idioms are ASCII — unrecoverable once pre-tail (measured drop)
Arabic-worded correction: no English scope marker — no scope section; survives via verbatim tail
EMAIL_RE is ASCII — email inside Arabic turn still extracted/tailed
Arabic month name + Arabic-Indic digits — no idiom matches; survives ONLY verbatim tail
